title: from_credentials precondition doc: 'Config::validate()' is ambiguous — which Config?
description: store.rs from_credentials doc says 'Config::validate() call' but there are three separate Config::validate() implementations (reader, smtp, imap). A new crate author wiring in a fourth service won't know they need to add their own validate() check. The precondition should list the three call sites explicitly or link to them, so a new crate author knows to add their own.
